title: Buitenkerkelijkheid in Nederland 1960
authors: Have, ten, NSS nv v/h Nederlandse stichting voor de statistiek * Den Haag (primary investigator)
contributors: NSS nv v/h Nederlandse stichting voor de statistiek * Den Haag (data collector)
descriptions: Non-affiliation with churches / family background on religion / attitude towards religious behaviour of children / motives for leaving the church / religious behaviour, church attendance, praying, bible reading, contact with clergy etc.. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education/ social class/ religion/ consumption of durables/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
